name: Lead Scout
tagline: Finds nearby small firms whose sites are under-optimised for search
description: Searches close by for small companies whose public websites look like they have never been tuned for search or answer engines, and writes a short file on each find. Those files go straight to the research bot that works downstream of it. It suits teams that already run outbound and want a fuller list.
author: itsryanlenk
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
